# shema_icons.c is the generated Shema icon set (design/shema-v2/firmware-assets).
# It is static LVGL alpha masks — no SVG decoder, no extra font — so it costs
# flash only, and is regenerated by that folder's generate_icons.py.
idf_component_register(
  SRCS "app_ui.c" "shema_icons.c"
  INCLUDE_DIRS "."
  REQUIRES lvgl app_player app_store app_power bible_data app_played
  PRIV_REQUIRES main sdcard_bsp)
